description: This file defines a generic DocumentManager class responsible for synchronizing documents between a document store and multi-level caches, utilizing distributed and memory caching mechanisms. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and invalidating documents with cache consistency and failover support.

classes.name: DocumentManager
classes.description: A generic service class managing synchronization of documents between a document store and multi-level cache, supporting distributed and volatile cache modes, with failover and cache consistency mechanisms.

methods.name: GetOrCreateMutableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a mutable instance of the document, considering cache modes and scope.

methods.name: GetOrCreateImmutableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an immutable instance of the document, with failover handling and cache synchronization.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates the document in cache and store, with optional post-update actions and cache invalidation.

methods.name: GetInternalAsync
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the document from cache or distributed cache, with failover support.

methods.name: SetInternalAsync
methods.description: Sets the document in cache and distributed cache, ensuring cache consistency.

methods.name: InvalidateInternalAsync
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries related to the document.

methods.name: GetFromDistributedCacheAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the document data from the distributed cache.

methods.name: UpdateDistributedCacheAsync
methods.description: Updates the distributed cache with the current document state.
